Bill.BriefDescription: Creating categorical exemptions from the state environmental policy act for certain activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to categorical exemptions from the stateenvironmental policy act for certain activities; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within urban growth areas designated under RCW 36.70A.110,decisions pertaining to the following activities are exempt from thischapter: (a) Construction of or location of any residential structuresof ten or fewer dwelling units; (b) division of land into nine or fewerlots or parcels; and (c) any landfill or excavation of five hundredcubic yards throughout the total lifetime of the fill or excavation. (2) The legislative authority of a county or city that is planningunder RCW 36.70A.040 may raise the exemption levels specified insubsection (1)(a) of this section by ordinance or resolution withinurban growth areas to a maximum of twenty or fewer dwelling units.
